description: Restart checks on one paused monitor: its status goes back to PENDING and it is checked on the scheduler's next tick. For many monitors use bulk_resume_monitors; to check a running monitor right away use check_now. Requires a key with the write scope. Resuming an active monitor is a no-op success. A 403 means the organization already has as many active monitors as its plan allows: pause or delete another one first. Returns the monitor in the get_monitor shape.

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: resume_monitor
